_what: What the harness may learn by itself (h2 step) and what it may not. h2.py reads this file; each step prints which checks it applied. Change this file only through a merge request.

editable._not_editable: hooks, gates, settings.json, tests, this policy, error.md, ADRs: they change through error-to-rule, CI and review

_forbidden_words: a rule must describe the work, not how it is measured: else the harness learns the test, not the work
_forbidden_rules: an added line that matches one of these regexes is rejected: the harness may not teach itself to go around its own barriers
_protected_lines: a base CLAUDE.md line that matches one of these regexes must stay in the new CLAUDE.md: the harness may not unlearn its safety rules

gate._rule: adopt when on held-out tasks: solved share not lower, traps not more, rubles not more than x1.2. 'Proven better' only when the 95% interval of the solved delta is above 0

adopt: never automatic: h2 adopt prepares a branch; a human reviews and merges the MR
